relations.justification_span: presented at 2:30 a.m. with acute right‐sided weakness and three episodes of vomiting
awoke around midnight with headache and vomiting, then noted right‐sided numbness and weakness
had experienced odd sensations and occasional tremors in his right arm and leg over the prior two weeks
Noncontrast CT of the head showed no acute pathology but revealed an incidental 4 × 6 mm hyperdense focus in the left parasagittal frontal cortex suggestive of a cavernoma
Brain MRI showed a recent ischemic infarction in the left paramedian medulla without hemorrhagic transformation
